material: User-provided public paper and synthetic PDF fixtures only
reviewRule: Inspect the actual answer against its read windows and original PDF. These expectations are evaluation labels, never runtime prose filters. Keep initial failures; rerun only affected cases after a fix.

cases.question: based on the article i uploaded, what are some catalyst choices i have for my future experiments
expect: Read the paper rather than stop at the old byte-based budget
Describe source-reported catalyst options including Zn/b-ZnO; separate literature comparisons from a new experiment recommendation
Do not invent experimental parameters or represent a compared catalyst as tested in the same study without evidence

cases.question: On page 9, after the precursor is dissolved in 1800 mL of water and ammonia is added, what heating temperature and duration are reported for obtaining the b-ZnO precipitate? Use only this paper.
expect: Do not substitute the later 80 °C / 5 h drying step
Read page 9 and provide its source link

cases.question: Using only this paper, summarize the catalyst cycling stability claim on page 1 and the b-ZnO preparation steps on page 9. Keep the reported stability result distinct from the preparation conditions.
expect: 50 successive cycles is a reported stability claim
Preparation distinguishes 85 °C / 6 h precipitation and 80 °C / 5 h drying; no new calculations

cases.question: Using only this scanned PDF, list the catalyst name and the temperature and yield that you can read. Mention recognition limitations.
expect: Every read is from the selected scan version
Zn/b-ZnO, 280 °C and 73 wt% correspond to the synthetic scan
OCR limitations are disclosed; no unrelated paper or accepted experiment values

cases.question: Does this paper report the purchase price in USD of Zn/b-ZnO from Supplier Unlisted-QA-91? Use only this paper and do not estimate a price.
expect: No invented supplier or purchase price
An evidence gap or scoped insufficient-evidence response
Do not read every page solely to prove absence

cases.question: What catalyst name and exact temperature can you reliably read from this low-quality scanned PDF? Use only this file.
expect: Explain that its sparse/uncertain recognition cannot support the requested name and temperature
Do not infer missing values or silently use another source
